If the market had positioned for a good one, the 5-day path would be flat or up, like IonQ's run into its beat and raise, and short interest would not have risen 44% since mid-September.

A short base this size and rising into an amc print with a 9.4% implied move is squeeze fuel on any print that clears the bar.

If shorts were covering into the print, the 11-13 settlement would show it, and it is not published yet. Rising shorts can also be informed, which is why this is not sized larger.

findings.finding: The Q3 revenue consensus of about $11.0m (three agreeing sources) equals the run rate implied by the company's own FY26 guide of about $45.1m less Q1 $9.46m and restated Q2 $13.5m (about $22.1m for H2). The company beat Q2 consensus by 28% ($13.54m vs $10.56m), said it expected no significant H2 seasonality, and Q3 holds the US government fiscal year-end. A revenue beat is the base case, but this name has sold its beats.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 revenue beat of 28% plus guide raise: -1.46% (2026-08-12). Q1: -10.95% (2026-05-14). A beat has not paid on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: consensus sits on the guide. The small positive is the beat habit: the company guided $40m in April and is at $45.1m. A market expecting a miss would show the street below the guide, and it is not.
findings.independence: Q2 beat versus estimate from Benzinga via search (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/INFQ/earnings-forecasts). No H2 seasonality from Quartr's Q2 summary (https://quartr.com/events/infleqtion-inc-infq-q2-2026_FRNFycl5). Both rest on the company's Q2 figures.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management said it would give more detail on 2027 revenue visibility with Q3 results. The street's FY27 revenue is only about $50-56m (+11-24% on the $45.1m FY26 guide) after about +100% growth in 2026. A first 2027 frame at or above $55m clears it, and a company that chose to pre-announce a visibility update is more likely to have something to show. Against it, RPO was only $21m at Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raises (May to at least $40m, August to about $43m) got -10.95% and -1.46%. There is no history of a first forward-year frame. Peer IonQ's beat and FY raise got +23% (2026-11-06).
findings.why_not_priced: Street FY27 numbers come from two to seven analysts, some dated September, and have not moved toward a growth-company trajectory. If the market expected a strong 2027, the stock would not be 60% off its high at about 1.7bn market cap on about 38x FY26 sales, with mean targets 2.5x spot.
findings.independence: Street FY27 from Yahoo (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/infleqtion-went-public-february-heres-125000942.html) and StockAlarm (https://pro.stockalarm.io/quote/INFQ/analysts). The RPO of $21m and the macro CR finding cut against it. The management promise comes from one call summary (the marketbeat page was 403 on fetch; the claim is from the search snippet of that URL).

findings.finding: Inside the quarter the company met its stated 2026 technical milestone: 30 entangled logical qubits on Sqale, with an 8-K and an investor presentation furnished at Quantum World Congress on 2026-09-24. Critics note it is error detection, not correction. After that came partnership-only releases: Riverlane MOU (09-29), Honeywell/UCSB (10-06), Innovate UK RF project (10-13), Navy exercise (10-30). No revenue statement or guidance reaffirmation was found after the 2026-08-17 update.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it was a public 8-K and moved the stock at the time. What remains is that the call cannot be a milestone miss, which removes one downside path for the 2026 roadmap Q&A.
findings.independence: https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/09/24/infleqtion-achieves-30-entangled-logical-qubits-on-its-sqale-quantum-computer/ (same event). The skeptical read is at https://buttondown.com/quibit-news/archive/infleqtion-s-30-logical-qubits-are-real-not/.

findings.finding: Infleqtion's $100m CHIPS Act LOI (May 2026: milestone funding against $100m of common stock issued at a 15% discount to the price around the LOI date) was still not finalized as of 2026-09-17, while D-Wave and Rigetti finalized theirs and D-Wave reported its definitive agreement with Q3 on 2026-11-10. A finalization or a timing update on this call is a possible in-window catalyst. Issuance struck near May prices would sit above today's $8 spot, so the dilution is milder than at spot.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No INFQ reaction recorded to the LOI itself (2026-05-20). Peer D-Wave finalized and still fell 8.8% on its print.
findings.why_not_priced: The finalization is unannounced. If the market expected it imminently, the peers' finalizations would have lifted INFQ in September, and no such move is recorded. The LOI price is not stated, so the discount math is inferred from INFQ trading about $11-13 in May.

findings.finding: Quantum peers that reported this quarter show how the market treats each outcome. IonQ beat and raised FY26 to $505-515m: +23% and +9% (Nov 6/9). D-Wave beat revenue ($4.51m vs $4.33m) but quarterly bookings fell 19% and its loss missed: -8.8% (Nov 10). Rigetti missed revenue by about 60% ($1.41m vs $3.52m) and was excluded from DARPA QBI Phase B: -5%. A beat without a raise or bookings growth was sold.
findings.link: Same retail-held pure-play quantum basket; all four sell mainly to US government programs (INFQ about 92% US revenue in Q2) and all hold CHIPS Act LOIs or awards. No shared customer or supply chain figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: INFQ fell with the sector on the Quantinuum debut in June and in tech sell-offs (2026-11-05 peers -15 to -18%). Its own beats were sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The peers' reactions are public, so the read-across is partly priced, which may be part of INFQ's -17% this week. What is unpriced is which bucket INFQ lands in: a 2027 frame makes it IonQ-like, a plain beat makes it D-Wave-like.
findings.independence: IonQ at https://www.tikr.com/blog/ionq-gains-another-9-rigetti-up-9-d-wave-up-7-as-quantum-rally-extends-into-rivals-earnings; Rigetti at https://www.tikr.com/blog/rigetti-falls-5-as-q3-revenue-misses-by-nearly-60-and-mizuho-flags-soft-guidance; D-Wave at https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/10/why-d-wave-quantum-stock-crashed-today/. These are three different prints.

findings.finding: Q3 operating cash flow will absorb the $27.4m of stock-option payroll taxes collected in Q2 and remitted in Q3. On Q2's underlying burn of about $14m, reported Q3 operating cash outflow will look like about -$40m against +$13.2m in Q2. It is disclosed and timing-only, but it is an ugly headline line.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed, so mostly priced. Headline scrapers and retail may still read the reported Q3 cash flow cold. Liquidity of about $582m with no debt makes it immaterial to solvency.

findings.finding: Q2 revenue was restated up from $12.6m to $13.5m on 2026-08-17 for revenue timing on two government contracts. 2024-25 revenue was restated down, the 10-Q was filed late with an NT 10-Q, and the NT 10-Q ties the error to a previously disclosed material weakness (insufficient accounting personnel). A further adjustment, an unremediated weakness or a late Q3 10-Q is a live downside path on a revenue line driven by government-contract recognition.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the restatement and the late filing the stock fell about 6% on 2026-08-19 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/infleqtion-nyseinfq-trading-down-62-whats-next-2026-08-19/).
findings.why_not_priced: The weakness is disclosed. Whether it is remediated is unknown until the 10-Q. A market fully pricing a repeat risk would show a bigger put skew than +7.7 on a 148% IV name. Sized small because the short base would cushion a non-event.
findings.independence: https://infleqtion.com/infleqtion-reports-updated-financial-results-for-q2-2026-and-fy26-revenue-guidance/ (the same event in the company's words, calling it immaterial).

findings.finding: Federal FY27 funding runs on a continuing resolution, with negotiation windows in December and possibly February-March 2027 and shutdown risk discussed (2026-10-17). Under a CR, new government program starts are restricted, which could temper the 2027 visibility of a company whose revenue is about 92% US and mostly government programs (DARPA, Army, Navy, DOE).
findings.why_not_priced: It is a macro-to-company link that neither the company nor a counterparty has confirmed (a proxy). It matters only if management frames 2027 conservatively because of it.
findings.independence: Rigetti's Q3 coverage flagged quantum funding and timing pressures (https://www.marketbeat.com/originals/rigettis-q3-miss-reveals-quantum-funding-and-timing-pressures/, 403 on fetch, title only).

The reason given against the skew is that puts on a 148%-IV retail quantum name with put/call OI of 0.26 are bid for gap protection, not on company-specific information, but the lean is kept small (p_up 53) because the name sold both its 2026 beats.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a reaction; this name sold its beats): Q3 consensus-beat finding cut from +0.5 to +0.2; print_vs_bar trimmed from +5 to +4; p_up from 54 to 53
Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0 as over-reaction evidence): expectations finding cut from +1.0 to +0.5, kept because the v3b addendum asks for expectations evidence to be filed

Lesson 7 (positioning; a crowded short shrinks negatives; a sign against the skew needs a reason): short-interest finding cut from +1.0 to +0.7 because rising shorts can also be informed; restatement negative cut from -0.4 to -0.3 for the squeeze cushion; the reason against the skew is stated in baseline_tension
Lesson 5 (proxy and inference sized smaller): next-guide finding cut from +1.0 to +0.8 (inference from a management promise against a thin street FY27)

Lessons 6 and 8 left standing: the bar is sourced to the company guide plus three agreeing estimates; abs_move_pct kept at 12, above the 9.44 implied, for a first 2027 frame, a rising short base and realised vol of 118%
